id: title:dmarchuk:label push registrations rejected by a capture billing limit

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated error class and status check for HTTP 402 billing-limit rejections, allowing the push-subscription capture path to distinguish billing-limit failures from other errors, potentially supporting tiered alerting or billing-specific recovery.
review.reason: The change introduces a new error class (`CaptureBillingLimitError`) and its handling, including a status check for HTTP 402 and a rejection response code. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in error handling and recovery for billing-limit scenarios, rather than a narrow maintenance or documentation-only change. No tier assignment is performed; this is a score of 2.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on downstream implementation of tiered alerting or billing-specific recovery, which is not demonstrated in this chunk. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
